title: Keep off-gated behavior documented but disabled

steps.action: Project a documented story targeted by an off flag.
steps.expected_result: The story remains present and is not reported as enabled.

steps.action: Project two documented stories whose feature is targeted by an off flag.
steps.expected_result: Both stories remain present and are not reported as enabled.

steps.action: Move each flag to on and project the same stories again.
steps.expected_result: The stories are enabled and no longer list the flag as a gate.

expected_result: Off gates produce implemented-not-enabled behavior without removing documentation, while on gates restore enabled behavior.
